name: awr-fleet
description: Robot roster as a service and a panel: who exists, who is busy, whose OTA is mid-flight
doc: Reads the AWR roster (~/.awr/robots.json, or $AWR_ROSTER) and publishes it as `awr.fleet`: list() returns every robot, get(serial) one, stale() whether the roster itself is old. A panel shows the fleet with its OTA stage, and a `fleet` command prints the same table. The roster is marked `sample: true` while it is placeholder data, and the panel says so rather than letting invented robots look real. Another mod (e.g. an OTA gate) consumes this service instead of re-reading the file. Read-only.

commands.name: fleet
commands.title: Print the robot roster
commands.doc: Table of serial, status, job, workspace, board and OTA stage, plus how old the roster is.
